Step into the shadowy past of one of Kansas City’s most charming neighborhoods on the Brookside History and Horrors Walk. This 1.5-hour guided tour will blend spine-chilling true crime stories with ghostly legends. From tales of organized crime and kidnappings to shocking murders and a few ghosts, prepare to uncover the darker side of Brookside’s history.​ Uncover the hidden layers of one of Kansas City’s most beloved green spaces.
